answers.core: Add-ons work inside the editor, not before the project starts
answers.workaround:
yes
I need to open my old project (or create a new one) folder with compatibility render, open the `project.godot` in Notepad, and copy the line:
```ini
[rendering]

renderer/rendering_method="gl_compatibility"
renderer/rendering_method.mobile="gl_compatibility"
```
And open my non-compatibility `project.godot` file, and replace the `[rendering]` section

title: Add a way to open/edit a project with different render modes (e.g., forward+ to compatibility)
